parent_objective: design artifact-only diagnosis for repeated matched-budget readiness-floor failure
blocked_by: M2236 pivots away from blind budget escalation toward task/curriculum readiness diagnosis

public_gates: M2237 must design an artifact-only diagnosis over M2230/M2234 training outputs
M2237 must identify diagnostic axes for seed/task heterogeneity, termination behavior, reward/training plateau, and readiness-floor calibration
M2237 must not run training, reset, rollout, measured execution, replay, PPO, or private holdout
M2237 must not rank profiles or claim finite-window-vs-GRU/self-ID evidence
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns matched-budget synthesis into an artifact-only diagnosis plan
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: diagnosis design only; no rerun ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if diagnosis would require new rollout before artifact audit
stop if design weakens readiness floors without evidence
fallback_plan: route to artifact-only implementation if design is clean
route to synthesis if existing artifacts are insufficient
route to task redesign only after diagnosis evidence

admission_evidence: M2236 synthesis pivots from budget escalation to task/curriculum readiness diagnosis
M2230 and M2234 provide complete finite training artifacts with repeated below-floor readiness
ranking and measured execution remain blocked
allowed_updates: M2237 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the design

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2237 designs readiness diagnosis and does not test causal history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No wrong-history, reset-hidden, zero-history, or measured execution intervention is run in M2237.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2230/M2234 training artifacts and M2236 synthesis.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Repeated below-floor evidence must diagnose task/curriculum/readiness before any self-ID claim or profile ranking.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: opens a new diagnosis axis after matched-budget synthesis
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can explain why the current-sim profile panel is below readiness floor
must_synthesize_if: M2237 cannot define artifact-only diagnostic axes
M2237 would require another blind budget run

hypothesis: An artifact-only diagnosis can localize why short-v0 and medium-v1 matched training remain below readiness floor before any new rollout or training.
success_criteria: diagnostic axes and input artifacts are explicit
no new reset rollout measured execution training replay PPO ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: design requires new rollout before artifact audit
design ranks profiles or weakens readiness floors without evidence
decision_rule: M2237 passes if it freezes an artifact-only diagnosis plan that explains repeated below-floor readiness without ranking or rerun.
